title: LLM中“机器遗忘”术语被滥用
summary: 本文指出，LLM研究中“机器遗忘”一词被过度使用，应仅指数据集定义的删除（使模型与重新训练几乎不可区分）。许多被标记为“遗忘”的任务（如拒绝有害请求、实体/知识移除）追求不同的策略目标，需要不同的术语和基线。术语混淆导致指标和基准被误用，奖励表面非披露而非真正的重新训练等价性。呼吁更严格的术语和匹配的评估。
summary_en: This position paper argues that 'machine unlearning' is overused in LLM research and should be reserved for dataset-defined deletion. Many tasks labeled as unlearning pursue different objectives and need distinct terminology. The confusion leads to misused metrics and benchmarks, rewarding surface-level non-disclosure. Calls for stricter terminology and evaluations matching the claimed objective.
